verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies bulk capability. Apps Script can automate Admin console tasks, and the Directory API returns paginated lists of all users in a domain, so admins could script operations over many users. Dynamic groups and group-level 2SV enforcement apply settings to many users at once. missing for 10: any documented batch/bulk API endpoint or bulk-edit UI, bulk operations on content items (files, mail, docs) rather than just users and policies, AI-native or agent-driven bulk workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
